responsibility: Declares the Rust front end’s procedural-macro loader and wrapper types. It defines lightweight objects for bang, attribute, and custom-derive proc macros that store the exported name, assigned NodeId, and callable bridge handle, and it exposes the API for loading proc-macro shared libraries and computing the exported declaration symbol name that the expander uses to discover procedural macro entry points.
same_name_distinction: Provides the declarations for the proc-macro loader subsystem in this module: the BangProcMacro, AttributeProcMacro, and CustomDeriveProcMacro wrapper types and the load_macros / generate_proc_macro_decls_symbol APIs. Unlike the .cc file, it does not implement dynamic loading, callback registration, or token/literal conversion bridging.
